authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8249 documents simple puch/pūch tail and nasal puṁcha/pū̃ch forms in the full prose and addendum. The short pucche/phučhi/pũči and Kullui puṇch forms match this family with nasal, aspiration and final-vowel notation retained and qualified. Pucchin 8250 denotes tailed animals and is not automatically substituted for every final-i tail form; local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: pũči.
